  "question": "Assess Eider Jet's reported maintenance backlog. I need the following measured result: September engines awaiting service and the median waiting time compared with June.",

Eider's maintenance queue has 18 engines waiting in September with a median wait of 11 weeks, versus 8 weeks in June; the waiting time lengthened by 3 weeks.

Background to the observation: Eider contracted a new engine maintenance provider.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
